svg.title: Flow figure: Worker app, Saved before?, Answer: DUPLICATE, Client allowed?, Answer: refused, Save in one transaction, Voucher OK?, Rolled back, Postgres, collection.created, Job orders, Stock, Push queue, Firebase push. Steps: Good record, Sent twice, Expired certification, No disclaimer.
svg.desc: The figure has these boxes: Worker app, Saved before?, Answer: DUPLICATE, Client allowed?, Answer: refused, Save in one transaction, Voucher OK?, Rolled back, Postgres, collection.created, Job orders, Stock, Push queue, Firebase push. Good record. The app sends a record. The server checks it is new. The client is allowed. The server opens one transaction. All three rows commit together. Listeners update jobs and stock, and queue a push. A worker sends the push to the phones. Sent twice. The app sends a record it sent before. The server finds it and answers DUPLICATE. Nothing is saved twice. Expired certification. The record is new. The certification expired. The server refuses the record. No disclaimer. The rows wait inside the transaction. The voucher fails. Every row rolls back. No table changes.

g.text: The app sends a record. The server checks it is new.
The client is allowed. The server opens one transaction.
Listeners update jobs and stock, and queue a push.
A worker sends the push to the phones.
The app sends a record it sent before.
The server finds it and answers DUPLICATE. Nothing is saved twice.
The certification expired. The server refuses the record.
The rows wait inside the transaction.
The voucher fails. Every row rolls back. No table changes.
